subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require live Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level tests and CI for this session/message-delivery change?
rationale: The changed path is user-visible Telegram/session delivery, and this read-only review cannot verify the real transport behavior from tests alone.

options.title: Require live delivery proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing completion delivery to the owning topic with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops completions.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery contract
options.body: Pause this narrow PR if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths first.

recommendation.title: Require live delivery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing completion delivery to the owning topic with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent high-confidence history in task recovery and silent subagent completion handoff code that this proof decision affects.
